reviewContext.userProblem: The remote CLI sends executeWorkflow followed by workflowExecution, but the Riela GraphQL server has no matching authenticated receiving roots.
requiredOutcomes: Implement the three accepted plans in dependency order with ordinary authenticated execution and a persisted summary through the actual Riela HTTP composition.
Reject absent or wrong bearer and unsupported top-level autoImprove or nestedSuperviser keys by presence, including false and null, without run side effects.
Pass relevant Swift tests, source build, strict changed-file SwiftLint and independent test-integrity, adversarial and integration reviews; commit and non-force push reviewed code and docs.
nonGoals: No parallel server or runner, queue, polling protocol, new library facade, legacy auto-improve compatibility or client timeout forwarding.
No historical-reference cleanup, separate P1 checkout edit, deployment, or P1 A2/A3 acceptance claim.
constraints: Preserve planning commit 9b1c935bc7e9fe4d586142e4ead035f84ef18ee7, local runs, existing GraphQL and browser authorization, and failure semantics.
Before implementation fanout, the serial owner must commit this accepted checkpoint, non-force push it, and verify live remote hash equals local HEAD; no such command has run in this node.
Run foreground verification with explicit Xcode Swift toolchain, complete logs and exit statuses under evidenceRoot per plan and attempt; serialize shared SwiftPM build/test use.
Workers keep separate progress files and do not edit this manifest; one serial owner handles shared catalog, indexes, reconciliation, reviews and final Git actions.
reviewContext.sharedPathIntent: NRE-03 alone performs serial catalog bindings, executor/DTO/schema parity adjustments, and directly related design refresh after NRE-01 and NRE-02 join; no concurrent worker edits these shared paths. No lockfile or index edit is planned.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Add typed GraphQL executeWorkflow and workflowExecution roots matching the existing CLI mutation-then-summary wire contract, with strict input validation before permissive decoding.
Verify a nonempty startup-configured operator bearer in an execution-specific wrapper before composite credential stripping; keep registry and browser authorization independent.
Add a strict read-only CLI session-record seam so corrupt stored rows yield storage errors while truly absent IDs yield null; pair it with the existing strict runtime snapshot read.
Use WorkflowRunCommand.run in the existing serve and browser compositions, await its persisted result, and keep host-selected working directory and store fixed for each request.
intentionalTradeoffs: Mutation stays synchronous; a client timeout can precede completion and retry may start a second run.
Execution bearer grants operator access within the selected host store, without per-user session isolation.
Desktop browser source-policy assertions may supplement but cannot replace real headless HTTP execution evidence.
supportedEdgeCases: Forbidden keys reject by top-level presence for false, null, zero, objects and true across variables, inline inputs and defaults; nested opaque runtimeVariables remain allowed.
Missing, mismatched or unconfigured bearer and spoofed manager-session/client metadata fail closed before starts or reads.
Absent summary ID returns null; corrupt CLI record, missing or corrupt runtime snapshot, and ID mismatch return execution errors.
Failed or paused persisted runs return actual status and exit code; server stop cancels and drains listener-owned route work.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Legacy auto-improve receiver behavior, timeoutMs wire forwarding, automatic retry or idempotency, and profile-wide lookup for unknown IDs.
reviewContext.reviewDecision: Step 5 implementation-plan review accepted; prior mid finding resolved in all three plans, with no high or mid findings remaining.

acceptanceCriteria: Typed receiving schema and provider protocol match the existing ordinary CLI wire fields and selection shapes.
Strict predecode validation rejects forbidden or unknown keys and invalid types; execution-only authorization fails closed before provider effects and preserves other domains.
Targeted GraphQL tests cover the positive response and forbidden-presence, authorization, selection and preflight negative matrix with nonzero discovered tests.
A narrow loadStrictReadOnly read distinguishes absent records from corrupt records and preserves legacy tolerant load behavior.
Deterministic store tests cover valid, absent, corrupt, mismatched and storage-failure records without read-side writes and with nonzero discovered tests.
Reconcile both predecessor interfaces and strict reads, then execute ordinary workflows through the existing CLI runner and host-selected store.
Actual Riela HTTP composition rejects unauthorized and malformed requests without effects and returns an authenticated persisted execution plus summary via the existing URLSession transport.
Provider, host, browser and cancellation tests pass; serial catalog/schema parity, source build, strict changed-file SwiftLint and aggregate tests pass with complete logs.
Independent test-integrity, adversarial and integration reviews accept source-matched evidence with no high or mid findings; directly related docs and progress records are finalized.
